title: Mweya Wakarinda paRwizi
intro: Mweya mudiki wakapihwa basa rakavanzika, rekuona ari kure zvakachengeteka mugumo uchiitika pamusoro pemvura. Munhu uyu, asingaonekwe uye asingafungidzirwe, aizoita basa guru mukuchinja mafambiro enhoroondo yenyika.
clues: Ndakapiwa basa naamai vangu, raida kungwarira uye kungwarira.
Maziso angu akatevera kamwana kadiki kaifamba-famba mumvura, moyo wangu uchinetseka zvikuru.
Payakawanikwa neboka risingatarisirwi, ndakaswedera pedyo, ndizere nekutya.
Ndakaona kusuwa kwavo muchengeti wemba ndikavapa mhinduro vasina kuburitsa chokwadi.
Kupindira kwangu panguva yakakodzera kwakadzosa mweya unoyamwisa kune uyo waida zvikuru.
Mumatare evane simba, ndakataura kuti: 'Ndingakutungamirai kumhuri ichamuchengeta nekumutarisira zvakanaka here?'
arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
